# Lazy Cat Tools

> Simple, free browser tools. No sign-up, no accounts. Just the thing you needed.

Lazy Cat Tools (lazycattools.com) is a collection of lightweight, client-side utility tools designed for everyday use. All tools run entirely in the browser — no data is sent to a server, no accounts are required, and everything is free.

## Tools

- [Random Team Generator](https://lazycattools.com/tools/random-team-generator/): Split any list of names into random, balanced teams. Supports 2–10 teams, uneven group sizes, file upload (.txt/.csv), random team name generation, and shareable result links. Used by teachers, coaches, trivia hosts, and team leads.

- [Random Name Picker](https://lazycattools.com/tools/random-name-picker/): Pick a random winner or participant from any list of names. Useful for giveaways, classroom callouts, raffle draws, and any situation where you need an impartial pick.

- [Coin Flip](https://lazycattools.com/tools/coin-flip/): Flip a virtual coin and get an instant heads or tails result. Simple 50/50 decision-making tool.

## Kitchen

- [Kitchen & Baking Converters](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/): Hub for all kitchen tools and ingredient charts.
- [Recipe Converter](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/recipe-converter/): Paste a whole recipe and convert every line to grams, or back to cups.
- [Recipe Scaler](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/recipe-scaler/): Halve, double or resize a recipe by servings, in real kitchen measures.
- [Cups, Tablespoons & Teaspoons](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/cups-tablespoons-teaspoons/): 1 cup = 16 tbsp = 48 tsp, plus fluid ounces and ml.
- [Butter Converter](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/butter-converter/): Sticks to cups, tablespoons and grams, and European blocks to sticks.
- [Oven Temperature Converter](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/oven-temperature/): °F, °C and gas mark, with fan oven settings.
- [Pan Size Converter](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/pan-size-converter/): Baking in a different pan? Get the number to multiply your recipe by.
- [Cups to Grams Converter](https://lazycattools.com/kitchen/cups-to-grams/): Convert cups, tablespoons, teaspoons, grams and ounces for 28 baking ingredients, using ingredient-specific weights (e.g. 1 cup all-purpose flour = 120 g, spooned and leveled).

## Site Pages

- [Home](https://lazycattools.com/): Tool directory listing all available tools.
- [About](https://lazycattools.com/pages/about/): Background on the site and its philosophy.
- [Contact](https://lazycattools.com/pages/contact/): Email for bug reports, corrections, and tool requests.
- [Privacy Policy](https://lazycattools.com/pages/privacy/): Tools run client-side; nothing typed into a tool is sent to a server. Google Analytics and AdSense cookies are explained.
- [Terms of Use](https://lazycattools.com/pages/terms/): Free to use; results provided as-is.

## About This Site

- **Owner:** Lazy Cat Tools / Culwell Creations
- **Monetization:** Google AdSense display ads
- **Tech stack:** Static HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript — hosted on Cloudflare Pages
- **Philosophy:** Ship simple tools fast, keep them free, no accounts or data collection
